comment: The chain world of the click's plan (the spec of 2026-10-18, sections C and D, and the conservation plan's blinds, written before any run; the owner's word of 2026-10-18: the files on the branch, the readings the owner's alone): one law-quantum of light on two bodies of three Nodes. A chain of 96 Nodes open on its axis with both faces receding (largest 400 by 16 layers), the two other axes folded to one Node; two records of the family `atom` ([1, 1299], the shape [2, 2], g at the count 1 and e at 0) declared NodeDetectors over three Nodes each, at the Nodes 60 to 62 and 20 to 22 along the chain, each taking the light `photon` into e at the transition's weight 6 and the resonance [5414, 6000] over a window of 48 intervals from the first lit interval (C2) and giving it back as a source in time at the lifetime 48 (the rate e to g, `gives_to` photon; C5: dark to its own source), the generators seeded 25 and 26; the light `photon` (the pair [6000, 6000], one real line) laid as one packet at k = pi / 4 from the Node 84 toward the lower side, the raised cosine of 8 beyond the top (one wavelength, no uniform mode), at the amplitude 110, one whole quantum in the record's own unit W_rec (C1: W_c sin omega at k = pi / 4; the books' count 1 read from the loaded world, lay_bounds.json); the run 400 intervals. The six worlds are this chain under the six signed permutations of the axes that carry a chain to a chain, B5 (the 48): along x, y and z, the light toward the axis's lower side (minus, the original along x) or its upper side (plus, the mirror image, every coordinate c to 95 - c), the bodies' Node lists the images in the original's order (the draw's order, `drawn`, is the declaration's: B5's one named exception). The trials the same lay with the records' generators at the hash of the declared seeds 25, 26, 27 (tools/meeting_trials.py). The seventh world, chain_detuned (C9 (b), the packet's length): the chain along x with the second body alone and one packet of the light at k = pi / 8, a flat top of 48 Nodes with the raised cosine of 8 beyond it (64 Nodes, monochromatic within the window, its passage over the body longer than the window), at the amplitude 53, one quantum in the record's unit at pi / 8, detuned from the transition's resonance; its eight trial seeds in detuned_trials.json. Every number stands here and the engine reads none.
